info.title: necodoc API
info.description: Render HTML to PDF, generate from published templates (singly or in batches), and combine PDFs. Authenticate with an API key in the `x-api-key` header. Every response carries `X-Request-Id`.

tags.name: Templates
tags.description: Published templates, their schemas, and generating from them.

tags.name: Generations
tags.description: Entries in the generation log, and their PDFs.
